_about: Inference settings of the Codex track's I6 model (learned-ROI detector + ResNet18 U-Net refiner), read by filseg/i6.py. Values are copied from the Codex tree: configs/growth-4.json (G4 recipe) and configs/improvement-i6.json (I6 protocol, sha256 229ccdee0f0eea9af68eb584dd5b03818bfe5d1e018b7c2e1fbe0a0094f61f24), or from the literals of scripts/i6_candidates_gpu.py / src/filament/g4_data.py that equal them. Each '_from' names the source.

detector.architecture: torchvision fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn_v2, box predictor replaced by FastRCNNPredictor(in_features, 2)
detector._from: configs/growth-4.json detector.{anchors,aspect_ratios,input} (read at i6_candidates_gpu.py L51) and proposal.{score_floor,per_tile_nms,max_candidates} (literals at i6_candidates_gpu.py L49)

refiner.architecture: ResNet18 U-Net (filament.gpu.model.ResNetUNet) with 2 input channels: raw, box hint
refiner._from: configs/growth-4.json refiner.{inputs,input,context_factor,minimum_context,micro_batch} (literals at i6_candidates_gpu.py L47, L65; g4_data.py L30, L42-43)

weights._from: runs/I6-{detector,refiner}-full-s20261014/run.json weights_sha256, model_digest, protocol_sha256 (checked at i6_candidates_gpu.py L42, L52-53)
